subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin likes it when plans are plainly split and everyone knows where they stand.
source_quote: Plain split. Everybody knew where they stood. I like it that way.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir feels the air in Candlekeep smells wrong, like anything does after too long breathing rock.
source_quote: The air in Candlekeep still smelled wrong to me. Not bad — paper, lamp oil, old stone warmed by sun I had not seen in months — just wrong, the way anything smells when you have spent too long breathing rock.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir has an old habit of standing near doorways because he learned to note exits before people.
source_quote: I had taken to standing near the doorways. Old habit. You learn the exits before you learn the people.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir believes Daz has forgotten everything that matters and kept everything that doesn't.
source_quote: He'd forgotten everything that mattered and kept everything that didn't.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir noticed Glabbagool's eye rise slowly and hopefully toward the bright thing in Daz's hand.
source_quote: An eye rose out of the grey of him — slow, hopeful, the way he does everything now — and pointed itself at the bright thing in Daz's hand, wanting to be useful.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir believes Glabbagool's instinct to reach toward problems is deeply valuable, though he says nothing out loud.
source_quote: I marked it and said nothing. Glabbagool survived Blingdenstone, the ooze crisis, the inside of a bag — and his instinct, every time, is still to reach toward the problem. I am not going to say out loud how much that is worth.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir observed Glabbagool retreat dolefully after his attempt to read the object failed.
source_quote: The eye sank back into the body. Dolefully. There is no other word for it; he retreated like a thing that had been told no.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir believes the most dangerous person in a room is the one who has already decided they've won.
source_quote: The Garden Shadow had a saying — or maybe it was Brother Tervin, the tall one who always smelled of incense, I genuinely don't remember, I wasn't listening — that the most dangerous person in a room isn't the one with the blade drawn. It's the one who has already decided they've won.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir distrusts convenient explanations, though he does not dismiss them.
source_quote: Convenient, that it all pointed one direction. I don't trust convenient. But I don't dismiss it either.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir thinks Glabbagool's question about silence is one that answers itself with time, or doesn't.
source_quote: I let that one go. Some questions answer themselves with time, or don't.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir noticed Glabbagool had no nose and considered it worth attempting to grow one.
source_quote: The ooze had no nose. That seemed like a thing worth attempting.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin believes lead-lined chalices would block far-seeing magic.
source_quote: Wouldn't lead choke off the magic that hunts down a hidden thing, the same way it blinds a scrying?

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin noticed the three junior avowed watching him before he spoke.
source_quote: I noticed the three of them watching before I'd said a word.

subject: Irony
fact: Irony has a compulsive need to always tell the truth.
source_quote: But I, you know, I really hate it when people make that joke. I'm so sorry — this compulsive need to always tell the truth.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin believes someone who always tells the truth is a very useful witness.
source_quote: I appreciate that," I said, and I meant it. "I am investigating a crime, so somebody who always tells the truth is definitely a very useful thing.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin noticed Janussi dropped the wrapping paper in a wicker basket by the door on his way out.
source_quote: Janussi took his unwrapped, thanked his secret donor, and excused himself, dropping the wrapping paper in a wicker basket by the door on his way out.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin realized the wrapping paper turned up in Janussi's office, not in the dining hall.
source_quote: The wrapping paper turned up in Janussi's office, not here.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin realized the poison might spread through the wrapping paper and should be handled carefully.
source_quote: It'd be something worth looking at. I would handle it very carefully, because we don't know how the poison would spread.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin did not know Sprig was the poison taster.
source_quote: Is she the poison taster?" I asked, and Irony said yes, like I should've known, and I hadn't.

subject: Thorin's heart
fact: Thorin left Janussi's heart in Waterdeep, but it is now found in the chalice, creating an unresolved mystery.
source_quote: I left it in Waterdeep.

subject: Daral's suspicion
fact: Daral suspects he is being framed, but his own emotional expression makes his claim seem performative.
source_quote: Maybe they wanted me to be blamed.
